about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Scott Franklin

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: This legislation fully funds veterans' healthcare and benefits, while strengthening mental health services, suicide prevention, and critical medical research programs relied upon by veterans across the country.
This legislation also protects the Second Amendment rights of veterans by preventing the VA from sending veterans' information to the FBI without due process and a judicial determination.
Mr. Chairman, I rise today in strong support of the fiscal year 2027 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act.
Mr. Chairman, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Recent missions in Venezuela and Iran underscore that these dangers are not hypothetical.
Maintaining our edge requires sustained investment in advanced capabilities, including artificial intelligence.
Mr. Chair, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 7148 and the Defense appropriations bill as part of this broader spending package.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It reins in the Biden administration's climate agenda that dismantled our energy independence and hurt American consumers.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 6938, which includes the FY26 Energy and Water Appropriations bill.
Mr. Speaker, this is a huge win for our national security and for all Americans, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EVENTS THIS WEEK
statements.title: EVENTS THIS WEEK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this evening as we recognize National Police Week, I rise to honor the brave men and women in uniform who serve with courage, integrity, and selflessness.
Every day, law enforcement officers put themselves in harm's way to protect our communities and uphold the rule of law.
Despite the danger, members of the Polk County Sheriff's Office and the Bartow Police Department responded swiftly to protect innocent lives.
Their story reminds us why we pause this week to honor law enforcement.
National Police Week is not only a time to honor those who were killed in the line of duty, but also to thank those who continue to answer the call with distinction.
